verdict.rationale: Slack has threads, and its AI can summarize channels and threads and produce daily recaps to help users catch up on busy channels (slack-docs-15). It does not organize every conversation under a named topic: community reports say Slack encourages posting in the main channel, keeps threads in a small side pane that is hard to use, and has weak thread-reply notifications (slack-comm-14, slack-comm-12). Missing for 10: mandatory or named topic organization for every conversation, first-party docs on thread structure, and positive hands-on evidence that threads make catch-up efficient.
